# Odiche Obiakarije — Data & AI Engineer

> Portfolio of Odiche Obiakarije (Odi), a Data & AI Engineer and AI architect
> with 5+ years building agentic AI, RAG systems, data-engineering pipelines,
> and enterprise automation. The site has two sides — professional and personal.

## Professional (https://odiobiak.github.io/website-me/)
- Focus: Agentic AI, RAG, Data Engineering, Enterprise Automation, AI Architecture.
- Experience: Data & AI Engineer at Accenture (Dec 2022–present) and Data Engineer
  at Rekor Systems (Oct 2020–Nov 2022).
- Case studies (each with an architecture diagram):
  1. Agentic AI — Multi-Agent Rebate Q&A Assistant (LangChain orchestrator,
     retrieval + evaluation agents, Pinecone, GPT-4o); ~60% faster Q&A.
  2. Data Engineering — Real-Time Traffic Pipeline (Kafka → Airflow → PySpark →
     Postgres warehouse → models & dashboards); 35% fewer errors, 60% less manual work.
  3. Enterprise Automation — Metadata Quality Agents (rule checks + LLM judge,
     structured outputs, human-in-the-loop); 40% fewer integration errors.
- Toolkit: LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, MCP, Pinecone, Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka,
  PySpark, Airflow, dbt, AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Python, SQL, FastAPI.
- Certifications: Snowflake SnowPro Core; Claude Architect (Foundations, Anthropic).
- Education: B.S. Computer Science, University of Pittsburgh (2019).
- Live AI assistant "Odi" answers questions about this work.
